content.title: Special Water & Sewer Districts
content.summary: Most residents and businesses in Arvada receive water and sewer services from the City of Arvada, but some areas are served by other districts. Notable districts include Ralston Valley Water and Sanitation District, Clear Creek Sanitation District, and Denver Water, each with specific addresses and contact numbers provided for residents needing assistance.
content.body:
Most residents and businesses located within Arvada receive water and sewer service from the City of Arvada. However, there are a few areas within the City boundaries that are served by other water and sewer districts.

- [Sewer District Map (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/473)
- [Water District Map (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/472)
